problem.name: Even–Mansour key recovery with classical queries
problem.statement_latex: Recover the keys of $E(x)=P(x\oplus k_1)\oplus k_2$ when the attacker may query $E$ only on classical inputs and may compute the public permutation $P$ coherently. This is the Q1 version of entry 88, with a materially different access model and complexity. The Q1 comparison counts classical encryption queries, coherent public-permutation evaluations and quantum gates; explicit permutations also admit classical bit-complexity bounds.

quantum.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(\sqrt{2^n/D})$ offline quantum time with $D$ classical encryption queries, offline Simon.
quantum.details_latex: For $D=2^u$ and $1\le u\le n$, Bonnetain et al. obtain the tradeoff $DT^2\asymp2^n$ up to polynomial factors in $n$. Total time includes data acquisition and has scale $\widetilde O(D+\sqrt{2^n/D})$. Reusable quantum states support the period tests with $O(n^2)$ logical qubits and polynomial classical memory. Only the public permutation is evaluated coherently; encryption queries are classical.

classical.headline_latex: $\widetilde O(2^n/D)$ offline work with $D$ encryption queries, generic classical Even--Mansour attacks.
classical.details_latex: The tradeoff $TD\asymp2^n$ gives total work $\widetilde O(D+2^n/D)$ and uses $O(D)$ classical storage. For a public permutation implemented by a $G_P$-gate circuit, enough known pairs give an explicit key-verification circuit of size $O(n+G_P)$, up to the fixed number of pairs. Tensor contraction yields $\operatorname{poly}(n+G_P)2^{O((n+G_P)/\sqrt{\log(n+G_P)})}$ classical key-recovery time. Families with $G_P=O(n)$ therefore have a subexponential classical comparator.

strength.description_latex: Quadratic improvement of offline work at fixed data volume in the generic Q1 model, combining Grover search with offline Simon tests. Optimizing total time over $D$ gives $\widetilde O(2^{n/3})$ quantum versus $\widetilde O(2^{n/2})$ classical work, a polynomial speedup of degree $3/2$.

hardware.description_latex:
The construction uses $O(n^2)$ logical qubits and polynomial classical memory while processing $D$ classical encryption queries. The offline computation takes $\widetilde O(\sqrt{2^n/D})$ time; cryptographic-scale coherent depth requires fault tolerance.

{\small [Before ``ETH is false'', the explicit-permutation comparison used classical $\widetilde O(2^{n/2})$ balanced work versus $\widetilde O(2^{n/3})$ offline Simon time.]\par}
